_note: League news that can change team strength. Maintained by the daily scheduled run; items older than 10 days are dropped. Summaries are in our own words with a link to the source. For kind qb_change, `to` becomes the team's current starter in the build.

items.summary: The Colts released starting quarterback Daniel Jones a day after benching him in a 26-3 loss to Houston. Anthony Richardson starts in Week 12 against the Giants.
